snippet.title: Smalland: Survive the Wilds - Crossplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Today’s update brings one of your most-requested features to Smalland: Survive the Wilds—crossplay is here! 

Whether you're playing on PC or console, you can now explore the world of Smalland together. Build, battle, and brave the wilds as a united tribe, no matter your platform. 

This is a major step forward for Smalland’s multiplayer experience, and we're thrilled to make it easier than ever to play with your friends. Thank you for your continued feedback and support—it helps us improve the game every step of the way. 

Play Smalland: Survive the Wilds Now
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008767
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/smalland-survive-the-wilds/9p2zt064fq6f
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/768200/Smalland_Survive_the_Wilds/
